_why: 1) Split In Batches fires its done branch again for every Stream Batch Done run n8n holds back (the rejected-candidate branch of Has Match? sits lower on the canvas, so n8n v1 runs it last). Each repeat reran the finalize nodes on a pool already handed on: in the 9 saved runs since the guard (2032-2048) Top N produced "No candidates passed the preliminary AI score threshold (25)." 21 times and Phase 2 produced 21 repeat completions, 18 with a lower total. By the code (n8n does not expose static data) both also overwrote hhSendProgress, which blinds the guard in Prepare Complete Search (line 24); none was posted only because the canvas order puts the real completion first and its hhCompleted check (line 30) then drops the repeats. Offline, with the real code, one extra held-back run between Finalize Phase 2 Send and its send posts the false "(25)" completion and drops the real one. 2) Apply AI Analysis paired answers with Map Candidate Fields' last N non-skip rows, but Has Match? also drops a row with a title and no name: every answer before such a row landed on the wrong person (0 of 260 recorded evaluations had such a row). 3) Is Phase 2?'s second clause calls $getWorkflowStaticData, which does not exist in n8n expressions: for every item without __phase2 === true it threw and rendered as false; it never contributed (same routing on 54 recorded runs, 1043 items), and under the opt-in vm expression engine it would fail the node.

A genuinely empty phase-1 pool now says "No candidates found: none of the profiles reviewed qualified for this search." Pairing is unchanged whenever no nameless row occurs (every recorded run). Is Phase 2? routes exactly as before.
_knownLimits: The marker trusts the first done firing of a phase to hold the whole pool. That holds while AI Analyze Candidate sits above Stream Batch Done on the canvas and executionOrder is v1 - the test pins both. If the order ever broke, the patched graph finalizes the partial pool once and reports exactly what it sent, where the base re-sends and posts a wrong total: measured offline, with the two nodes swapped on the canvas, exec 2048 delivers 0 (base: 14 with a false "(25)" completion); with an extra held-back run before a phase's last batch, 12 instead of 14 (base: 14 sent, posts 12) and 16 instead of 24 (base: 24 sent, posts 16). n8n v1 never produces those orders and the empty-chain close removes the stall that could. The empty-pool wording also covers a pool emptied by failed model calls (score 0), as the old text did. hhFinalized is one more per-search static-data key that is never pruned (about 60 bytes per search), like hhCompleted. An empty phase-1 pool still ends the search without trying phase 2 (unchanged). Prepare Complete Search's comments are not updated.
